psk.title: Enter the Open API PSK
psk.description: Enter the base64 key Ebeco emailed you after you enabled local API for {name} in the Ebeco Connect app (Device → Settings → Functions → Enable local API). It is validated with a live handshake before the device is added.

error.invalid_auth: Handshake failed — the key was rejected by the device. Check you used the key emailed for this thermostat; keys are per device.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect — is the thermostat powered on and in range?
error.psk_wrong_length: Decoded key must be exactly 32 bytes.

data.rated_watts: Heating element wattage (0 disables the derived energy and power sensors)
data.use_room_sensor: Use the room sensor (instead of floor) as the climate entity's current temperature

get_home_program.name: Get home program
get_home_program.description: Reads the weekly Home program schedule from the thermostat.

set_home_program.name: Set home program
set_home_program.description: Writes part or all of the weekly Home program schedule to the thermostat. Use Days + Events to apply one schedule to several weekdays at once, or the Per day section for days that differ. Omitted days are left unchanged; a day's remaining slots keep the device's existing times, marked inactive.

days.name: Days
days.description: Which weekdays the Events schedule below is written to.

events.name: Events
events.description: Up to 4 events, each with a time, a temperature in degrees Celsius, and an Active toggle. Clear Active to keep a slot's time but stop it firing - that is how a slot is switched off; the device always holds 4 slots per day and an inactive one still needs a valid, in-order time.
